Complete Overhauling, Repairing, Testing of 110 HP, 1 905547072 3.3KV HT Motor. Detail Scope of work as per annexur NUMBER 1 e. Important Note to Bidders: 1. L-1 will be decided on overall L-1 basis. Price will be firm, fixed and final during the entire execution period of contract. 2. Price submission by the bidders either in hard copy or in the techno-commercial Part-I bid or in their letter head shall be summarily rejected. 3. Price Bid uploaded in GeM Bid Document is only for reference purpose, price quoted in price BOQ is not considered for L-1 evaluation in GeM Tender. 7. The motor application is extremely critical and used Ore Crushing application. So, for better clarity, assessment and estimation, Site visit (Annexure-VI) is mandatory before submitting offer. Party has to submit proof of site visit along with bid documents, failing which their offer shall not be considered for further evaluation. 8. Bidder shall refer " Buyer Added Bid specific ATC" for all other terms and conditions, scope of work, form at for submission of EMD/SD in the for of Insurance Surety Bonds/Bank Guarantee in HCL prescribed fo rmat. Annexure-I (PQC) PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA: 1. Party must have to provide executed order copy/copies of successfully executed contract/s for re-wind ing/repairing of Min. 3.3 kV class, Min. 110 HP motor in PSU/Govt. Organizations/Listed Private Compani es having CIN (Corporate Identification Number) for atleast of following value in last 7 years ending last day of the month previous to the date of publication of the enquiry. (a) One executed Order copy of basic value not less than Rs. 5.94 Lacs or (b) Two executed Order copies of basic value not less than Rs 3.71 Lacs for each or (c) Three executed Order copies of basic value not less than Rs 2.97 Lacs for each (Copy of work order and job completion certificate from the concerned organization evidential for the si milar nature of work, contract tenure preferably with dates and executed basic amount on completion i s to be uploaded in techno-Commercial Offer.) 2. The Bidder shall have positive net worth as per their latest audited financial statement. Relevant docu mentary evidence including copies of Annual Report, containing Profit & Loss Statement and Balance S heets for immediate preceding three (3) consecutive accounting years ending 2026 shall be furnished t ogether with the Bid. The bidder should have an average annual turnover of Rs. 2.22 Lacs in the last th ree preceding financial years. The Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss account statement should be sign ed by Chartered Accountants. The audited account should contain UDIN,FRN,MRN of the CA/CA Firm.

3. The motor application is extremely critical and used ore crushing application. So, for better clarity ass essment and estimation, Site visit is mandatory before submitting offer. Party has to submit proof of sit e visit along with bid documents, failing which their offer shall not be considered for further evaluation. Annexure-II (TECHNICAL REQUIREMENT) ESSENTIAL TECHNICAL REQUIREMENT FOR TENDER ACCEPTANCE: 1. The motor application is extremely critical and used Ore Crushing application. So, for better clarity , assessment and estimation, Site visit is mandatory before submitting offer. Party has to submit pr oof of site visit along with bid documents, failing which their offer shall not be considered for furthe r evaluation. 2. The party should have successfully completed re-winding/repairing of Min. 3.3 kV class, Min. 110 H P motor in recent past. Against this, bidder has to provide executed PO copies and completion certi ficate issued from client mentioning performance of the repaired motor. These documents to be su bmitted alongwith part-1 bid, failing which their offer not be considered for further evaluation. Annexure-III (SCOPE OF WORK) Detail Name of Work: Complete rewinding of stator of One No. 110HP, 3.3KV, 960RPM, Star c onnected Squirrel cage induction motor. Application of motor: Ore Crushing application, Belt driven motor with 4 ft Symon Cone Crusher The detail scope of work is as below. (i) To & Fro transportation of the motor from our premises to party’s workshop. Loading/ unloading at o ur premises shall be under scope of HCL. But loading/unloading at party’s workshop shall be under sc ope of party. (ii) Complete rewinding of the damaged stator of the motor. The job includes dismantling the motor, clea ning of the stator after extracting the burnt coils from stator, complete overhauling, preparing new EC Grade Copper conductor of same size and dimension, applying Insulation, varnishing as per class F. Pr eparing fresh leads. Testing the R,L values of the stator coil. ** Party has to provide 2 sets of newly prepared copper coil. Each set containing 3 coils in series, as s pare for future use at our workshop. This is in addition to the actual nos. of stator coil required for mo tor re-winding. ** Old damaged copper conductor of the stator to be retained by the party. So, bidder has to quote dedu cting the price of the old damaged coils. (iii) Complete overhauling of the rotor including dynamic balancing and trueness checking and brazing w ork of rotor bars. (iv) There is no issue with bearings. But as they have become old, party has to provided new bearings (D E and NDE) for the motor as per the existing make and series or equivalent SKF make bearing. All new bearings to be procured with PDI certificate to ensure originality. If required, bearing housing modifica tion or replacement to be made by party without any additional cost. The bearings PDI certificate copy to be provided to HCL/ICC. ** old bearings to be returned to HCL along with motor.

(v) Motor assembling, testing and body painting. Final load trial shall be taken in presence of party’s rep resentative at our site. NOTE: 1. All motor testing and parameter measurements shall be done in presence of HCL. 2. After dismantling of motor the HCL/ICC representative shall visit the party’s workshop to access the condition of the stator and rotor, before taking up the job of repairing of motor. 3. After repairing of stator and rotor the HCL representative shall visit the party workshop for testing of st ator and rotor in dismantle condition. After successful testing and clearance the motor shall be assembl ed and testing shall be done as per standard in presence of HCL representative. 4. The motor no load and load trial run shall be done finally in presence of party at our site. The acceptan ce certificate shall be issued after 15 days of successful load trial after which it’s bill shall be processed for payment. 5. Indemnity bond of Rs 8.0 lacs to be submitted before lifting the motor for repairing on non-judicial sta mp paper on prescribed proforma duly notarized for safe custody of the motor taken for repair by the c ontractor in his own name from the State of Jharkhand at its own cost. Apart from this, proper authoriz ation letter will have to be submitted in person for lifting the motor. 6. Transit insurance of motor as per requirement if any, shall be under scope of party. 7. Party must have all facilities for HT motor (3.3KV or more class) repairing/winding. The bidder should h ave at-least followings Lists of repairing facilities like lathe machines, dynamic balancing machines, hyd raulic press, winding machines, Coil making machine, turning machines, test facilities for HT motors, no load run facilities etc. This lists to be submitted against part-1 bid. 8. GUARANTEE: Party has to provide 12 months guarantee of repaired motor against repairing job/workm anship/ quality materials from the date of acceptance (post load trial run) of the delivered motor at our site OR The party has to provide 18 months guarantee of repaired motor against repairing job/workma nship/quality materials from the date of received of motor at HCL/ICC Mosabani Plant. 9. PBG: The supplier shall also furnish a Bank Guarantee towards performance to the total of 10% of total order value after acceptance (post load trial run ) of the motor at our site against the materials & work manship of repaired motor, which should be initially valid for 18 months from the date of acceptance of motor and shall be released only after successful completion of guaranteed period. . 6.
